entities.summary: HD 73526 c is an extrasolar planet orbiting about 97 million miles away from its parent star. Based on its mass, this planet is likely to be a gas giant. At the distance this planet orbits from its star, which is more luminous than the Sun, HD 73526 c would receive insolation 84% that of Venus.
